entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I placed about a month ago for the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
Certainly. Can I get your full name and order number to pull up your account?
Of course. The name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... one second... VF-8815-92C.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th for the VeloBand Pulse. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's definitely a preference thing. To be honest, it was a bit of an impulse buy. I've basically changed my mind and I just don't use it as much as I thought I would. I know it's been a little over a month, but I'm hoping we can work something out.
I understand completely. It's important that you're happy with your VeloFit products. Let me just pull up our current return guidelines for you.
Thanks. I was looking into options for resale but I figured I'd call first. Even a partial credit would be great, if a full return isn't possible.
Okay, one moment... alright. I've got our policy right here. It looks like you're well within the return window.
Oh, really? I thought I might be too late.
Not at all. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. Since you received it 32 days ago, we can definitely cannot offer a refund for you. No problem at all.
Wow, that's fantastic news! Thank you so much, Isaac. I really appreciate that.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
Nope, that's everything. You've made this very easy. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
